purpose: Train-only appearance, reference diversity and repetition engineering gate; zero training
variant_scope: Apply after frozen predicted atlas. Brightness/gamma/query-gray change query only; grayscale_both changes query and original bank via frozen v1 code.
candidate_policy: Original training photos only; one case per photo; choose least-represented available physical tyre first, then deterministic contrast-descriptor diversity/coverage/glare score. No validation/test image or score enters selection.
low_texture_policy: Retain and flag low texture; do not exclude smooth tread as presumed bad wear truth.
structural_expectation: 18 cases from18 distinct train photos; class tyre counts1/3/4 remain; new independent tyres0
equivariance_scope: Diagnostic relative feature L2 under the fixed appearance probes, stratified by class and clipped-pixel fraction; no v2 classification or causal-invariance claim.
native_retention: Per-image original atlas RGB/valid/grid, frozen dense masks/points, probe probabilities, source hashes and numerical summaries; direct native .pt and .npy, never archives
